issues.title: Training too short: all best checkpoints at epoch 295-300 of 300
issues.description: All 18 models (6 conditions x 3 seeds) had best checkpoints at epoch 295-300, with val_loss still decreasing at training end. Extended training from 300 to 600 epochs with T_max=590 (after warmup). Best epochs now at 580-600 range.

issues.title: No weight decay or warmup in optimizer
issues.description: Switched from Adam to AdamW with weight_decay=1e-4 for better generalization. Added 10-epoch linear warmup to stabilize early training with higher LR.

issues.title: Conservative learning rate
issues.description: Increased initial LR from 1e-4 to 2e-4. The 1.2M parameter decoder can benefit from faster initial convergence. Combined with warmup to prevent training instability.

summary: Extended training to 600 epochs with AdamW (weight_decay=1e-4), 2x higher LR (2e-4), and 10-epoch warmup. BIWI: LVE improved 99.7-99.8% (condA: 0.003771->9.00e-6, condB: 0.003286->8.08e-6, condC: 0.003121->8.19e-6). VOCASET: LVE improved 39-64% (condA: 1.35e-5->4.84e-6, condB: 7.5e-6->4.55e-6, condC: 8.7e-6->4.57e-6). Rankings preserved: B > C > A on both datasets.
